facts.fact: The High Commission for Digitalisation, with the National Hajj and Umrah Office, added a new 'Hajj digital services' service to the national portal for government digital services, announced in a statement of 11 September 2026 for the 1448H/2027 season, with citizens asked to open portal accounts first.
